# ESL-plans.com

> Ready-made ESL lesson plans for adult learners. Conversation-driven topics covering psychology, business, technology and society. PDF, audio and video included, A2–C1 levels, built for online ESL tutors.

## About
ESL-plans.com is run by Alex, a practising online ESL tutor with 15 years of experience teaching adults. Every lesson is written by him, tested on real students, and designed for adult learners rather than children — topics include psychology, workplace culture, technology and society.

- Author page: https://esl-plans.com/about/
- Library size: 127 lesson plans, 26 of them free
- Levels: A2, B1, B2, C1 (CEFR)
- Every lesson includes: PDF handout, answer key, discussion questions, and audio and/or video

## Pricing
- Guest: Free — access to the 26 free lesson plans, no account
- Contributor: $19/month — the full library
- Friend: $99/year — the full library + planner app + mentoring + private chat
